audience: his followers, business owners and employees
caption_vs_video_note: The caption is a long written argument (employees are passive, 1 percent of heroes carries the 99 percent cowards) that the video shows only as a selfie answer to a news-based question; the caption states the thesis, the video's own words are not available.

engagement.comment_notes: Approximate hand count over 45 sampled comments plus replies. Mostly strong disagreement: commenters list employees who acted (a pilot, a firefighter, soldiers, a bus driver, medical staff) and call the claim populism; the top comments (790 and 451 likes) correct him on the pilot being an employee. A few praise it as marketing ('המשווק הכי גאוני בישראל'). Not representative of 282 comments.

rights_and_privacy: A news-style photo of an aircraft and a person on a plane with a blurred face; four small portraits (unblurred) and a screenshot of a news text naming people; bystanders in the background identifiable. A sensitive real-world incident.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: a news-hook with an extreme, quotable claim about employees versus owners; the comment fight and 2,776 shares show it was discussed widely, though not that it persuaded anyone.
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: the claim was factually challenged in the comments (an employee pilot landed the plane), which could damage trust.
